legislature.scope_note: The source booklet explicitly compiles replies delivered in both Houses and is preserved as one edited two-House witness.

speech.event_ta: 1971-72 ஆம் ஆண்டுக்கான நிதிநிலை அறிக்கை மீதான விவாதங்களுக்கான இரு அவை பதிலுரைகளின் தொகுப்பு
speech.event_en: Edited compilation of replies to the debates on the 1971-72 financial statement in both Houses

transcription.gate_c_completion_note: Gate C first-pass Tamil transcription is complete for all 57 body pages, scans 4-60 / implied printed pp.3-59. Source-page markers 4-60 occur exactly once and in order. The first pass carried three unresolved readings at scans 11, 31 and 37; Gate C.5-3 resolved the scan-31 classroom anecdote directly from the controlling pixels, leaving two unresolved readings at scans 11 and 37.
transcription.gate_c5_note: Gate C.5 COMPLETE / PASS. All 57 body scans (4-60 / implied printed pp.3-59) were audited directly against rendered source pixels. Final C.5-6 scans 54-60 added 22 definite textual corrections across 19 source sites; cumulative Gate C.5 corrections are 129 across 109 source sites. Two readings remained unresolved at C.5 closure (scans 11 and 37); both were later resolved by explicit, user-authorized emendation from the official 30-06-1971 Legislative Council debate record. Current unresolved readings: 0. No other outside wording was imported.

post_c5_official_record_resolution.note: Two booklet loci that remained unreadable after direct scan review were explicitly resolved from the corresponding official Legislative Council debate record. These are documented editorial emendations, not additional Gate C.5 pixel-supported corrections.

resolutions.resolved_text: ஆகவே வட்டிக்காக அரசுக்குக் கொடுக்கப்பட்ட தொகை போக ஏற்படுகிற நட்டம்தான் குறிப்பிடப்பட்டிருக்கிறதல்லாமல், வட்டியும் கொடுக்காமல் நட்டம் ஏற்பட்டிருப்பதாகக் கருதுவது சரியல்ல.
